paragraphs: nextRec sells cloud based software for running parks and recreation departments, from program registration to facility rentals, with a self service side for residents. Buyers range from small villages to large counties and the government staff in between.

Staff set up single or recurring classes, courses, drop-ins, and programs, with conflict checking built in. The booking side covers indoor and outdoor facilities, parks, fields, campgrounds, meeting spaces, and party venues. Payments, memberships, and product sales run through the same system, online or on-site. Reports can be created, run, and exported in real time.

The same platform is marketed to K-12 schools and to higher education institutions. Associations use it so members can pay and manage their own accounts at any hour. The company says the platform complies with PCI, ISO, and SOC standards. Customers keep ownership of their data, which the site says stays in its country of origin. Support is offered 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

quote.text: Frictionless, All-In-One Parks and Recreation Management Software
